skill_name: Compare and contrast print media and digital media.
workflow: Print media and digital media differ in a number of ways. Print media is a physical medium, typically involving paper or other materials, while digital media is a digital format displayed on a computer or other electronic device. Additionally, print media is typically static and immutable, while digital media can be updated and edited instantly.
